answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, with transition mass damped and normalized by verified stake. A Sybil cluster can gain influence only through its boundary: if its external cut has conductance φ, spectral mixing and min-cut transitivity bounds cap the probability mass, and therefore aggregate voting weight, as a function of φ and walk length. Labels such as lotus, vault, and jetty do not alter this bound.
